goal: Strict absolute relative reproduction error <5% for as many of the fixed 123 pairs as honestly possible (111 for >90%)
stage_selection: Stages were chosen from code-provenance evidence (diagnosis.json, specs/) before any new test metric existed. Scope rules are outcome-independent: every pair sharing the cited provenance is declared, including currently passing pairs.
replacement: Every complete predeclared stage replaces its predecessors for all its pairs, including regressions; a stage with any incomplete or failed job is not adopted for any pair; no closest-test choice.
reference_pin_note: 2026-11-01: pin moved from the snapshot file hash to the frozen per-cell reference copy, so later snapshot additions (extra cells without references) cannot alter any of the 424 references.
